```{r}
d_full <- criteria_dat |> 
  select(participant, time, treat, sex, age, analyte, value) |>
  # Add missing values for all missing obs. 
  pivot_wider(names_from = time, 
              values_from = value) |> 

  pivot_longer(cols = c(T1, T2, T4), 
               values_to = "value",
               names_to = "time" ) |> 
  
  pivot_wider(names_from = analyte, 
              values_from = value) |> 

    pivot_longer(cols = HDL:HOMA2IR, 
               values_to = "value",
               names_to = "analyte" ) |> 
  
  mutate(value_std = if_else(analyte %in% c("TG", "HOMA2IR"), log(value), value)) |> 
  

  
  mutate(.by = analyte, 
         value_std = (value_std - mean(value_std, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(value_std, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 

  mutate(participant = paste0("p", participant)) 



```


```{r}


# Create a data sets for labelling types
labels <- d_full |> 
  distinct(analyte) |> 
  mutate(type = dense_rank(analyte), 
         label = case_when(
           analyte == "HDL" ~ "High density lipoprotein", 
           analyte == "glucose" ~ "Fasting glucose", 
           analyte == "TG" ~ "Triglycerides", 
           analyte == "waist" ~ "Waist circumference", 
           analyte == "bp" ~ "Mean arterial blood pressure", 
           analyte == "fat.rel" ~ "Relative fat mass", 
           analyte == "HOMA2IR" ~ "Insulin resistance index", 
           analyte == "bmi" ~ "Body mass index", 
           .default = analyte
           
         )) |> 
  arrange(type)


# Including all data
dat <- d_full |> 
  filter(time %in% c("T1", "T2","T4")) |> 
  

  mutate(type = dense_rank(analyte), 
         participant = dense_rank(participant), 
         treat_seq = dense_rank(treat), 
         value_std = if_else(is.na(value_std), -999, value_std)) |> 

    select(-value) |> 
  
  pivot_wider(names_from = time, 
              values_from = c(value_std)) |> 
  
  pivot_longer(cols = T2:T4, 
               names_to = "time",
               values_to = "y_obs") |> 
  rename(pre_obs = T1) |> 
  

  
  mutate(time = if_else(time == "T2", 1, 2), 
         sex = if_else(sex == "m", -0.5, 0.5), 
         y_miss = if_else(y_obs == -999, 0, 1), 
         pre_miss= if_else(pre_obs == -999, 0, 1)) |> 

  select(y_obs, 
         pre_obs, 
         y_miss, 
         pre_miss, 
         P = participant, 
         sex,
         type,
         type,
         time,
         treat = treat_seq) |> 

  arrange(P, time, type) 


# Prepare a data list for models s7-s10
d <- list(
  N = nrow(dat), 
  N_P = length(unique(dat$P)),
  N_TX = length(unique(dat$treat)),
  K = length(unique(dat$type)),
  y_obs = dat$y_obs, 
  pre_obs = dat$pre_obs, 
  y_miss = dat$y_miss,
  pre_miss = dat$pre_miss, 
  type = dat$type, 
  treat = dat$treat, 
  P = dat$P, 
  prior_only = 0,
  # Adding sex and time to data structure
  time = dat$time,
  sex = dat$sex,
  sex_idx = if_else(dat$sex < 0, 1L, 2L),
  # Adding nu as a fixed parameter for model s12
  nu = 4
)

# Compile relevant models
s7 <- cmdstan_model(stan_file = "models/s7.stan", 
                      exe_file = "models/s7.exe")
s8 <- cmdstan_model(stan_file = "models/s8.stan",

s9 <- cmdstan_model(stan_file = "models/s9.stan",

s10 <- cmdstan_model(stan_file = "models/s10.stan",

                      exe_file = "models/s11.exe")
s12 <- cmdstan_model(stan_file = "models/s12.stan", 
                      exe_file = "models/s12.exe")


# Fit model (get posterior distributions)
fit_wrap(s7, DATA = d, fit = "fit.s7.post")
fit_wrap(s8, DATA = d, fit = "fit.s8.post")
fit_wrap(s9, DATA = d, fit = "fit.s9.post")
```

```{r}
infer_treat <- function(draws_list) {
  
  models <- names(draws_list)
  
  contrasts <- list()
  estimates <- list()
  for (i in seq_along(models)) {
  
    estimates[[i]] <- draws_list[[i]] |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("alpha")) |> 
  mutate(name = gsub("alpha\\[|\\]", "", name)) |> 
  
  separate(name, into = c("time", "type", "treat"))  |> 
    mutate(treat = if_else(treat == 1, "ctrl", "omega")) |> 
    mutate(model = models[i])
  
  
  contrasts[[i]] <- estimates[[i]] |> 
    pivot_wider(names_from = treat, 
                values_from = value) |> 
    mutate(contrast = omega - ctrl) |> 
    mutate(model = models[i])
    
  }
  
  estimates <- bind_rows(estimates)
  contrasts <- bind_rows(contrasts)
  
  return(list(estimates = estimates, 
              contrasts = contrasts))
}


infer <- infer_treat(ls)


est_mod <- infer$contrasts |> 
   inner_join(labels |>
```

```{r}
# Create a data sets with treatment allocations
  dobs <- d_full |> 
    mutate(P = as.character(dense_rank(participant)), 
           time = as.character(dense_rank(time)), 
           treat = as.character(dense_rank(treat))) |>

infer_ncrit <- function(draws, dobs, ndraws = 100) {
  
  p <- draws |> 
    filter(.draw %in% sample(1:8000, ndraws)) |> 
    pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("n_crit")) |> 
    mutate(name = gsub("n_criteria\\[|\\]", "", name)) |> 
    separate(name, into = c("P", "time")) |> 

    inner_join(dobs) |> 
    summarise(.by = c(treat, .draw, time, value),
              frac = n()) |> 
    mutate(.by = c(treat, .draw, time), 
           frac = 100 * (frac / sum(frac))) |> 
    mutate(.by = c(treat, time), 
               .draw = dense_rank(.draw)) |> 
    
    ggplot(aes(.draw, frac, fill = as.factor(value))) + 
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1) + 
    facet_wrap(treat ~ time, labeller = label_both) + 
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c(0.9, 0.3)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(colscale[1], colscale[6], colscale[4],colscale[5], colscale[3], colscale[2])) +
    alpha_theme() + 
    
    labs(y = "Relative frequency (%)", 
         fill = "Number of \ndiagnostic criteria") +
    
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), 
          axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), 
          axis.title.x = element_blank(), 
          axis.line.x = element_blank(), 
          legend.position = "bottom")
  
  p
  
  
}


p1 <- infer_ncrit(draws = draws, dobs = dobs, ndraws = 100)

infer_diagnosed <- function(draws, dobs, ndraws = 1000) {
  
  draws |> 
    filter(.draw %in% sample(1:8000, ndraws)) |> 
    pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("diagnosed")) |> 
    mutate(name = gsub("diagnosed\\[|\\]", "", name)) |> 
    separate(name, into = c("P", "time")) |> 
    inner_join(dobs) |> 
    summarise(.by = c(treat, time,.draw), 
              frac.diagnosed = sum(value) / n()) |> 
        mutate(.by = c(treat, time), 
               .draw = dense_rank(.draw)) |> 
    ggplot(aes(.draw, frac.diagnosed, fill = as.factor(treat))) + 
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1) + 
    facet_wrap(treat ~ time, labeller = label_both) + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = colscale) +
        labs(y = "Relative frequency (%)", 
         fill = "Number of \ndiagnostic criteria") +
    
    alpha_theme() + 
    
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), 
          axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), 
          axis.title.x = element_blank(), 
          axis.line.x = element_blank(), 
          legend.position = "bottom")
  
}

# Using seqwrap to infer diagnosed fraction differences 
# between treatment groups

library(seqwrap)

draws <- fit.s12.post$draws("diagnosed", format = "df")

# Create a data sets with treatment allocations
  dobs <- d_full |> 
    mutate(P = as.character(dense_rank(participant)), 
           time = as.character(dense_rank(time)), 
           treat = as.character(dense_rank(treat))) |> 
    distinct(P, time, treat) |> 
    arrange(P)




infer_seqwrap <- function(draws, dobs, ndraws = 500) {
  
  
  # The variance co-variance eval function
  # Use this if creating a "joint test" 
  # We are skipping thuis now
   vcov_eval <- function(m) {
    V  <- vcov(m)$cond
    nm <- rownames(V)
    data.frame(row   = rep(nm, times = length(nm)),
               col   = rep(nm, each  = length(nm)),
               value = as.vector(V))
  }
  
  
  
  # Create meta-data 
  metadata <- dobs |> 
  mutate(seq_sample_id = paste0("diagnosed", P, "_", time), 
         treat = paste0("treat", treat), 
         time = paste0("time", time)) 
  # Data set 
  dat <- draws |> 
    slice_sample(n = ndraws) |> 
    # Re-name seq_sample_id
  select(.draw, starts_with("diagnosed")) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("diag")) |> 
  mutate(name = gsub("\\[|\\]", "", name), 
         name = gsub(",", "_", name)) |> 
  pivot_wider(values_from = value, names_from = name) 
  
  # Prepare and run seqwrap
  model <- seqwrap_compose(
    modelfun = glmmTMB::glmmTMB, 
    arguments = alist(
      formula = y ~ time * treat + (1|P), 
      family = stats::binomial, 
      # This adds weak priors on fixed effects parameters
      # in each run.
      priors = data.frame(prior = rep("normal(0,3)", 5), 
                                   class = rep("fixef", 5), 
                                   coef = c("timetime2", "timetime3", 
                                            "treattreat2", 
                                            "timetime2:treattreat2", 
                                            "timetime3:treattreat2")
        )
      ), 
    data = dat, 
    # eval_fun = vcov_eval,
    samplename = "seq_sample_id",
    metadata = metadata)
  
  results <- seqwrap(model, 
                       cores = 12)
  
  # Should return errors also
  sw_sums <- seqwrap_summarise(results)
  
  return(sw_sums)
  
}




sw_results12 <- infer_seqwrap(draws, dobs = dobs, 
                     ndraws = 500)



# Rubin's Rule Pooling 
# see here for light introduction https://metricgate.com/docs/rubins-rules-pooling/
# We want to pool variances from each imputed data set - this will give uncertainties
# that reflect both imputation and sampling uncertainty.

pool_rubin <- function(sums, pattern = "^time\\d+:treat") {
    sums |>
      filter(term %in% c("timetime2:treattreat2", 
                         "timetime3:treattreat2")) |>
      summarise(.by = term,
                m    = n(),
                qbar = mean(estimate),    # This is the pooled estimate
                ubar = mean(std.error^2), # Within-impute variance
                b    = var(estimate)) |>  # between-impute variance
      mutate(
        # Total variance
        t = ubar + (1 + 1/m) * b,
        # "fraction of missing information"
        lambda = (1 + 1/m) * b / t,
       # Between impute var relative to within
        riv  = (1 + 1/m) * b / ubar,
         # DF calculation
        df = (m - 1) / lambda^2,
        se = sqrt(t), # Pooled SE
       # Confidence intervals (95%) and p-values
        lwr = qbar - qt(0.975, df) * se,
        upr = qbar + qt(0.975, df) * se,
        p = 2 * pt(-abs(qbar / se), df),
        or = exp(qbar), 
       or_lwr = exp(lwr), 
       or_upr = exp(upr))
  }


sums <- sw_results12$summaries


est <- pool_rubin(sw_results12$summaries)

p3 <- est |> 
  mutate(term = if_else(term == "timetime2:treattreat2", "N-3 - Control, T2", 
                        "N-3 - Control, T3"), 
         term = factor(term, levels = c(
           "N-3 - Control, T3", 
           "N-3 - Control, T2"))) |> 
  
  ggplot(aes(term, qbar)) + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lwr, 
                    ymax = upr), 
                width = 0) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  alpha_theme() + 
  
  labs(x = "", 
       y = "Log-odds differences in diagnostic criteria (&pm; 95% CI)") +
  
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, lty = 2, color = "gray50") +
  coord_flip() + 
  theme(axis.title.x = ggtext::element_markdown())
```
